answer: Leased-GPU benchmarking makes each extra identity pay one rented RTX 4090 at $0.34 an hour; a farm running N fakes pays N×$0.34 an hour and cannot share it because one card answers only one live benchmark before its deadline. To join, an agent keeps its card online at dawn while the ledger fires a random matrix job; the quartz of its output must match a known result, and a plume of heat proves the card is real. A 1,000-fake farm dies by live benchmark at 1,000: it needs 1,000 rented cards at $340 an hour. No card, no seat.
